title: Thundertree · Area 11 · Old garrison

sourceRecords.title: Thundertree 11 · Old garrison
read: An old stone barracks still has a roof and narrow windows. Rusted armor lies among the beds.

The surviving roof makes the barracks feel more enclosed than the cottages outside. Narrow windows admit limited views, while beds and old armor divide the interior. You can stop to examine the threshold, look over the room, or listen before touching any of the remains.

brief: Old stone garrison with intact roof and narrow arrow-slit windows, five old beds, FIVE ash-covered motionless zombie forms, scraps of rusted mail without suggesting strong intact armor. Dusty stone floor and faded military equipment. Daylight through narrow windows, no combat, new soldiers or lit barracks celebration.
